inputs.prompt: Create ONE square opaque directly overhead flat albedo texture study for Vaelora, an original hand-painted fantasy RTS. Entire image is ground, no horizon, no perspective, no standing objects, no cast shadows, no lighting gradients, no words or borders. IMPORTANT composition must be irregular and aperiodic, with generous quiet bare zones and UNEVEN spacing. NO concentric shapes, nested contours, swirling flow, diagonal bands, branching fractal noise, uniform allover speckles, symmetry, or repeated tiny motif grid. Mostly simple quiet sage and buttery green painted grass masses. A few widely separated modest patches of tiny ivory field flowers, subtle dried straw, occasional muted clover. 90 percent quiet ground, only 10 percent accent details.

REMOVE the photorealistic granular dirt, densely detailed cracks, tiny speckling, embossed relief and realistic lighting. 85 percent quiet smooth painted ground. No shadows, no 3D relief, no gradient lighting, no text, no scene, no horizon. Remove diagonal banding, do not add waves, spirals, branching networks or fractal contours. It must feel illustrative and painted, with broad friendly shapes readable beneath a small RTS army. Opaque square ground fills all edges.
